transit.name: Steamboat Springs Transit
transit.detail: Free bus system. Summer service runs April 13 through November 27, 2026, followed by the winter routes.

nameOrigin.text: The City says French trappers in the early 1800s mistook the sound of a natural mineral spring for the chugging of a steamboat engine.

founded.text: James H. Crawford filed the Steamboat Springs claim

timeline.text: The railroad arrived, and tourism to the mineral springs grew.
Howelsen Hill has operated since 1915. The City calls it Colorado's oldest continuously operated ski area.
Dorothy Wither founded the town's history museum.

sites.name: Steamboat Springs History Museum
sites.hours: Tuesday–Saturday 11 am–5 pm; closed major national holidays
sites.cost: Adults $6; seniors 62 and over $5; children 6–12 $2; under 6 and Routt County residents with ID free

sites.name: Howelsen Hill Ski Area
sites.hours: Monday–Friday 11 am–8 pm; Saturday and Sunday 10 am–4 pm; closed December 25; hours subject to change
sites.cost: 2026/2027 lift tickets: adults 19–64 $55; youth 5–18 $40; seniors 65 and over $40; 4 and under free; free skiing every Sunday

makers.name: Moots
makers.what: Handcrafted titanium bicycles, built in Steamboat Springs since 1981
